We need to count carbonyl groups in the molecule. But we have no description of the molecule. Possibly the system expects us to use NMR or IR to detect carbonyls. Carbonyl groups show characteristic IR around 1700 cm-1. Could use ir_spectra tool to get IR and count peaks? But we need count of carbonyl groups. Could also use carbon_nmr_spectra to see carbonyl carbon shifts (~190-220 ppm). But we don't know molecule.

We need to retrieve the molecule? The prompt doesn't give SMILES. Maybe the environment has a sample at hand (the compound). So we can run IR to detect carbonyl peaks. Use ir_spectra tool. Then parse output for C=O stretch peaks. Count them.

Let's call ir_spectra.
